mentions.name: Passkey Extension
mentions.description: A minimalist browser extension that allows passkeys to be stored and used. Created to understand how passkeys work and to explore passkey use cases not covered by other products.
mentions.source_excerpt:
This is a minimalist extension that allows passkeys to be stored and used.

I created this small extension firstly to understand how passkeys work, and secondly to see if there might be an interesting use case not covered by other products.

All feedback is very welcome.
https://github.com/gppmad/passkey-extension
